title: cyanthillium cinereum var. viale
intro: Cyanthillium cinereum var. viale, commonly known as Bitter Leaf or Cnidoscolus, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antimicrobial agent, and exhibiting antioxidant properties, thus contributing to its use in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cyanthillium cinereum var. viale include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
